title: Utility Line Protection Plans Field Note: Steel Plating and Cold Patch Amounts on Emergency Openings
content:
# Field Note: Steel Plating and Cold Patch Amounts on Emergency Openings

Field operations note for public sidewalk, curb and street openings under the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Public-way plating addition: an emergency request on which a temporary repair has been authorized adds the plated public-way addition, for the steel plating and cold patch that hold the opening until the permanent restoration; an emergency request with no temporary repair authorized on it adds the patched public-way addition; every other request adds no public-way plating addition. The public-way plating addition is added to the public-way restoration figure as a flat dollar amount.

## Amounts

| Urgency recorded on the request | Temporary repair authorized on the same request | Public-way plating addition |
|---|---|---|
| emergency | yes | $250.00 (plated) |
| emergency | no | $125.00 (patched) |
| routine | either | none |

## Reading the records

The temporary repair counted is one authorized on the same service request, as shown in the claim history.

## Hypothetical examples

- Emergency water line request with a temporary repair authorized on it: $250.00 is added.
- Emergency request with no temporary repair on it: $125.00 is added.
